description: This file is a shell script used to manage cron jobs for uploading WiFi logs. It contains functions to start and stop the scheduled log upload task, interacts with system files such as device properties and crontab, and encapsulates logic for managing WiFi log upload operations.

methods.name: start_cron_job
methods.description: Sets up a cron job to periodically copy WiFi logs every 30 minutes and creates a flag file to indicate initiation.

methods.name: stop_cron_job
methods.description: Removes the WiFi log copy cron job from crontab and deletes the flag file.
